goal: Create a platform-native news × fictional-video satire package from a verified current event and an owner-supplied fictional clip.
audience: Technology and internet-culture viewers who follow current events but dislike generic news recaps and forced meme copy.

content_contract.core: Find the event-specific contradiction and make the supplied fictional visual add a second layer of meaning without retelling its plot.

hard_constraints: Separate verified facts, attributed reporting, allegations and unknowns.
Inspect exact media bytes before making visual claims.
Verify rights and likeness before release.
unknowns: Rights and identity are unknown until evidence is supplied.
success_criteria: News and visual have mutual semantic relevance without plot recap.
The copy is natural and genuinely platform-specific.
Factual and fictional layers are not confused.
